samples.summary: `login` bypasses the now-universal upstream-error envelope contract this delta asserts
samples.evidence: The delta's new docstring at packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:153 claims "Every command that talks to the backend routes its `!res.ok` branch through here", and packages/cli/README.md:124 now promises "Every command reports the same code for that condition, so the branch does not depend on which subcommand ran." `login` is a command that talks to the backend and does not: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:62-67 prints plain text `Token exchange failed...` (no JSON envelope) then `process.exit(1)`; the same at login.ts:79-82 (`Failed to fetch user info.`) and login.ts:96-101 (`Failed to fetch workspaces (HTTP <status>)...`). An agent branching on `error.code` from stderr gets unparseable text from these three backend failures, including the 401/403 case. Fix belongs either on login.ts (route through `forwardUpstreamError`/`outputError`) or on the new claim in formatter.ts:153 / README:124, which is currently overbroad.

samples.summary: Backend 401/403 still exits 1, while the design doc's error matrix requires exit 2 for that case — the delta makes the deviation apply to every command
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:1038 documents `Backend 401/403 → Exit 2 / UNAUTHORIZED`, and packages/cli/README.md:128 says exit `2` for auth failures. `forwardUpstreamError` sets `process.exitCode = 1` (formatter.ts:175) for a forwarded envelope, and the `UpstreamHttpError` path lands in `outputError`, which also sets 1 (formatter.ts:62). By routing the remaining ~20 backend commands (docs/notes/slides/files/api-keys/sheets) through this helper, the delta makes exit-1-on-401 the uniform behaviour, so any script branching on the documented exit 2 for auth (e.g. the SESSION_EXPIRED envelope from http-client.ts:157-164) never sees it. Exit code itself is unchanged from before for these commands, so this is an inherited contract gap the delta generalises; the fix is either an exit-code mapping in the new central helper or a correction to docs/design/cli.md:1038.
